title: Pre-registration of H1 (dated-universe trend) and H2 (funding carry), G0.7
precedence: This file governs wherever it and docs/PREREGISTRATION.md disagree.
status: Draft of 2026-11-11 for the CTPO's review and the owner's signature. Binding only once the commit holding it is tagged prereg-v1.

decisions.D3: paper short perpetual positions approved for H2
decisions.D4: the owner alone holds the holdout key
decisions.D12: a position in an instrument that stops trading is closed at the worst price of its last daily bar
decisions.D13: a pair is eligible only once its current instrument has a close 120 days before the month-end close
decisions.D15: H2's second criterion is in excess of a beta-matched buy-and-hold; H1's stays volatility-matched

data.unrecorded_gap: the run fails and its trial entry still counts

clock.daily_return: the return of UTC day D is equity marked at D+1 00:00 divided by equity marked at D 00:00, minus one
clock.funding_known_at_t: a settlement is known at decision time t if its published calc_time is at most t plus 60 seconds

out_of_sample_windows.no_decision_at: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z in any development run, because its fill would fall in the holdout
out_of_sample_windows.positions_at_window_end: marked at the last close, never closed; no exit cost is charged

walk_forward.design: expanding window anchored at the start of the archive; test folds are calendar years
walk_forward.training_window_use: signal lookbacks, volatility estimates and the volume ranking only
walk_forward.joined_out_of_sample_series: the configuration's daily net returns over its whole out-of-sample window

trial_definition.trial: any harness run of a configuration in hypotheses.H1.configurations or hypotheses.H2.configurations that produces a return for any day of that hypothesis's out-of-sample window
trial_definition.kind_is_decided_by: the registered configuration the run resolves to, never by a label the caller supplies

other_kinds.control: a configuration in controls with a seed in its registered range
other_kinds.sensitivity: a candidate configuration re-costed as in sensitivity, run only after the ledger freeze
other_kinds.holdout: the one holdout run of the holdout candidate

trial_definition.returns_outside_registered_windows: refused, except the holdout run after the unseal

n_counting_rule.N: the number of trial entries in the frozen ledger, from the genesis entry to the freeze tag, across H1, H2 and the reserve
n_counting_rule.counts: every trial entry opened, whether it completes, fails or is aborted; reruns of the same configuration each count
n_counting_rule.read_from: the ledger only; no statistic accepts N as an argument from a caller

budgets.reserve_use: only after the hypothesis has used its own 12 entries, only for a rerun of a registered configuration, and only with a recorded reason
budgets.exhausted_budget: the hypothesis cannot run further trials; if it has not passed, that is a fail

run_rules.order: every registered configuration of a hypothesis is run in the registered order, whatever earlier results show
run_rules.completeness: a hypothesis is judged only when every one of its registered configurations has a selectable run; otherwise it cannot pass and its entries still count
run_rules.rerun_requires: a recorded defect: what was wrong and the commit that fixes it, in the rerun's entry
run_rules.rerun_scope: a fix to code both hypotheses use (harness, loaders, fills, costs, statistics) reruns every configuration already run; a fix confined to one hypothesis's strategy code reruns that hypothesis's configurations already run
run_rules.selectable_run: a configuration's last completed trial entry at the freeze
run_rules.consistency: all selectable runs of a hypothesis were produced by identical harness and strategy code, as recorded in their entries

costs.slippage_model: huginn executor: execution price is the reference price moved 2 bps against the order (SlippageBps = 2); the square-root impact term is off (SlippageImpactK = 0)
costs.fee_base: traded notional at the execution price
costs.applies_to: every fill of every leg, spot and perpetual, entries and exits

fills.reference_price: VWAP of the 15-minute bar opening at the decision time: quote-asset volume divided by base volume
fills.missing_or_zero_volume_bar: use the next 15-minute bar with volume
fills.lapse: the order is dropped, the position is unchanged and the next decision re-evaluates
fills.position_changes_at: the close of the fill bar
fills.perpetual_leg: the perpetual's own 15-minute bar opening at the same time, by the same rule

marks.daily: each instrument's daily close at 00:00 UTC; the perpetual's own daily close for the short leg
marks.missing_daily_bar_during_an_exchange_out: the last available close is carried forward
marks.funding_mark: the close of the latest perpetual 15-minute bar at or before the settlement time

instruments.definition: a maximal run of consecutive daily bars of one spot symbol in the pinned archive
instruments.split: a missing daily bar ends the instrument; later bars of the symbol form a new instrument with no history
instruments.cross_symbol_links: none: renames, redenominations, migrations and forks are not linked
instruments.perpetual_for_a_spot_pair: the USDT-margined perpetual on the same coin, including 1000PEPEUSDT, 1000SHIBUSDT, 1000FLOKIUSDT and 1000LUNCUSDT; a settlement applies to the spot instrument whose dates contain it
instruments.funding_accrual: per published settlement at its published rate; never a daily rate times three

halted_or_delisted.applies_when: an instrument ends before the end of the window being run
halted_or_delisted.long_position: closed at the low of the instrument's last daily bar, then slippage and fee as for any sell, booked at that bar's close
halted_or_delisted.short_position: closed at the high of the instrument's last daily bar, then slippage and fee as for any buy, booked at that bar's close
halted_or_delisted.slot: holds cash until the next month-end universe update

universe_H1.update: at each month-end close, the decision at 00:00 UTC on the 1st
universe_H1.ranking: USDT spot symbols, without the base assets in exclusions.removed_before_ranking, by quote volume over the 30 daily bars closing at the month end, delisted symbols included, exactly as norse_research.universe.rank_month_ends with depth 10
eligibility: the symbol is not in an excluded category
the symbol's current instrument has the month-end daily bar
the current instrument has a daily close 120 days before the month-end close (D13)
universe_H1.members: the first five eligible symbols in rank order among the ten largest
universe_H1.fewer_than_five_eligible: the empty slots hold cash for the month; this never happens at a development month end

categories_dropped_after_ranking.fiat_stablecoin: a token designed to hold a fixed value in a fiat currency, not already removed before ranking
categories_dropped_after_ranking.leveraged_token: a token whose value is a leveraged multiple of another coin's return (Binance UP, DOWN, BULL and BEAR tokens)
categories_dropped_after_ranking.off_chain_asset_token: a token designed to track an asset outside crypto: commodity-backed tokens, tokenised shares, funds or other securities
categories_dropped_after_ranking.wrapped_or_staked: a wrapped, bridged or liquid-staking form of another coin

exclusions.review_before_signing: the CTPO checks the other ten holdout-only candidates (BANK, CHIP, DEXE, FOGO, NIGHT, RE, SENT, TAO, TUT, ZAMA) against the categories from each token's own published description, and adds any that falls in one to classified_candidates before the tag

H1.name: time-series trend on a dated universe, long or flat, spot only

rules.vote: 1 if the instrument's close at the decision divided by its close the lookback earlier, minus one, is above zero; otherwise 0
rules.signal: the mean of the votes, so 0, 1/3, 2/3 or 1
rules.volatility: square root of the exponentially weighted mean of squared simple close-to-close returns, not demeaned, alpha = 2 / (span + 1), weights (1 - alpha)^j over every return of the instrument (pandas ewm(span, adjust=True)), annualised by the square root of the bars in a year
rules.band: trade an instrument to its target only if the absolute difference between target and current weight exceeds rebalance_band times the target weight
rules.weights: fractions of equity marked at the decision; the remainder is cash
rules.four_hour_bars: lookbacks and the volatility span are converted to bars at six a day; volatility is annualised by the square root of 2190; the universe still updates only at month-end 00:00 decisions; a decision whose four-hour bar is missing is skipped
rules.funding_filter: the signal is set to 0 while the sum of the coin's perpetual funding settlements with calc_time in the 7 days up to the decision exceeds flat_if_sum_above; if the coin has no perpetual, or its perpetual's settlements do not cover the whole 7 days without a recorded gap, the filter does not apply

H2.name: funding carry: long spot and short USDT-margined perpetual in equal quantity, BTC and ETH

rules.trailing_funding: for each coin, the sum of its published funding rates with calc_time in the lookback_days up to the decision
rules.thresholds: entry_threshold = entry_multiple * round_trip_cost * lookback_days / 28; exit_threshold = exit_multiple * round_trip_cost * lookback_days / 28
rules.enter: a flat coin enters when its trailing funding is above entry_threshold
rules.exit: a coin in carry exits when its trailing funding is below exit_threshold
rules.entry_size: spot quantity q = allocation_per_coin * equity / spot reference price; buy q spot and sell q perpetual at the same 15-minute bar
rules.holding: quantities stay fixed until the exit, which sells q spot and buys q perpetual
rules.funding: at each settlement while short, receive q * funding mark * rate (pay when the rate is negative)
rules.margin: spot and perpetual margined jointly; liquidation is not modelled
rules.always_on: enter both coins at the first decision and never exit

benchmarks.rule: at each month-end decision, trade to 1/5 of equity in each H1 universe member (cash for empty slots); no trading between month ends; same fills, costs and D12 rule as H1
buy BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT spot at half of equity each at the first decision, and trade back to half each at every month-end decision; same fills, costs and D12 rule as H2

controls.rule: votes are computed on a synthetic close series per instrument, starting at its first close and compounding its actual daily simple returns with each day's sign flipped independently with probability 1/2; volatility, sizing, universe and P&L use the actual prices
controls.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(seed), one draw per instrument-day in order of symbol then date

controls.rule: each coin's trailing funding for the entry and exit decisions is computed from its development funding series shifted circularly by k settlements, k drawn uniformly from the integers 540 to M - 540 where M is the coin's number of development settlements; funding received and P&L use the actual series

sensitivity.split: slippage stays 2 bps a side; the fee is the remainder
sensitivity.use: reported in the tear sheet; never part of a pass criterion

statistics.returns: daily net returns over the configuration's out-of-sample window
statistics.sharpe: mean divided by standard deviation with T - 1 in the denominator, per day, not annualised; zero if the standard deviation is zero
statistics.skewness: m3 / m2^1.5 with m_k the k-th central moment using 1/T
statistics.kurtosis: m4 / m2^2, Pearson (3 for a normal distribution)
statistics.psr_z: (SR - SR*) * sqrt(T - 1) / sqrt(1 - skewness * SR + (kurtosis - 1) / 4 * SR^2)
statistics.dsr: Phi(psr_z with SR* = SR_0), SR_0 = sqrt(V) * expected_max_z(N)
statistics.V: sample variance (denominator: the number of selectable runs minus one) of the per-day Sharpe ratios of every selectable run in the ledger, both hypotheses, each over its own window; for DEV-2 the same over their excess-return Sharpe ratios; 1/T of the candidate's window if fewer than two selectable runs exist

pbo.matrix: columns: the hypothesis's selectable runs in registered order; rows: daily net returns over its window
pbo.trim: drop the earliest T mod 16 rows; blocks are contiguous and equal
pbo.in_sample: the 8 blocks of the combination, in time order; out of sample the other 8
pbo.metric: the per-day Sharpe ratio as defined above
pbo.selected: the column with the highest in-sample Sharpe; ties to the lowest column index
pbo.oos_rank: ascending rank of the selected column's out-of-sample Sharpe among all columns, 1 the lowest, ties averaged
pbo.pbo: the share of the 12870 splits with logit at or below zero

statistics.min_track_record_days: 1 + (1 - skewness * SR + (kurtosis - 1) / 4 * SR^2) * (1.6448536269514722 / (SR - SR*))^2, reported for SR* = 0 and SR* = SR_0; not reached when SR <= SR*
statistics.bootstrap: circular block bootstrap, block 20 days, 10000 resamples, numpy.random.default_rng(20261111), 5th and 95th percentiles of the annualised Sharpe; reported only

development.test: dsr of the candidate's daily net returns

dsr of the candidate's excess returns: H1 r - k r_B with k = sd(r) / sd(r_B) over the window (B-H1); H2 r - beta r_B with beta the least-squares slope, intercept included, of r on r_B over the window (B-H2, D15)
Sharpe of the window's daily net returns with each calendar year removed in turn
Sharpe of the window's daily net returns without the 20 largest daily returns (ties: earliest dates first)

holdout.test: per-day Sharpe SR_h of the holdout candidate's 304 holdout daily net returns, against SR_w over its development window
holdout.pass: SR_h > 0 and SR_h >= SR_w - 1.6448536269514722 * sqrt((1 - skewness_w * SR_w + (kurtosis_w - 1) / 4 * SR_w^2) / (304 - 1)), with skewness_w and kurtosis_w from the development window

reported_not_criteria: family PBO over all selectable runs on their common days

candidate_selection.hypothesis_candidate: the selectable run with the highest DEV-1 dsr; ties to the earlier registered configuration
candidate_selection.hypothesis_passes_development: its candidate meets DEV-1 to DEV-5; no other configuration of the hypothesis is judged
candidate_selection.holdout_candidate: among hypotheses that pass development, the candidate with the higher DEV-1 dsr; ties to H1
candidate_selection.no_candidate: no unseal and no holdout run

holdout_run.unseal: names the prereg-v1 commit and file hashes and the holdout candidate's configuration hash, and is accepted only with the owner's key (D4)
holdout_run.simulation: one simulation of the candidate configuration from the start of its development window through 2026-10-31, positions carried across the boundary; HOLD-1 reads only the returns of 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-31
holdout_run.retry: a run that fails before producing a result may be retried under the same unseal for the same configuration only, every attempt ledgered
holdout_run.nothing_else_on_the_holdout: no other configuration, benchmark, control or sensitivity run reads holdout data
holdout_run.data: the holdout files are fetched again at the unseal and verified against the holdout manifest (owner's decision of 2026-11-11); a file that fails verification stops the run before any return is computed

verdict.PASS: the hypothesis passes development and its candidate was the holdout candidate and passes HOLD-1
verdict.PASSED DEVELOPMENT, NOT TESTED ON THE HO: passes development but the other hypothesis's candidate was the holdout candidate
verdict.FAIL: otherwise, once every registered configuration has a selectable run
verdict.NOT RUN: not every registered configuration has a selectable run at the freeze

change_control.before_the_first_trial: a change needs a new tag (prereg-v2 and onward) and its reason recorded in the change log of docs/PREREGISTRATION.md
